observation: Headings, nav, buttons, labels and eyebrows use Helvetica Neue/Arial sans-serif. Body copy, list items and inputs use Georgia serif. The page pairs a sans display face with a serif text face.
evidence: fonts_by_element_count: Georgia 127, Helvetica Neue 73, Arial 2. h1 font_family is "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif.

observation: The h1 is a 64px bold sans in cream (rgb 244,236,220) over a dark hero photo. It is left-aligned at x=180 and is the largest type on the page. There is exactly one h1.
evidence: h1 font_size 64px, weight 700, color rgb(244,236,220); h1_count 1; rect 180,219,896x67.

observation: Every section opens with a small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow label above a 32px bold h2. The eyebrows are rust red on light sections, peach on the dark destinations section, and orange-tan in the hero.
evidence: Eyebrow texts: OWNED AND OPERATED BY ALASKANS, FLIGHT SEARCH AND BOOKING, WELCOME, FLYING WITH US, DESTINATIONS, NEWS, NEWSLETTER, CAREERS, CONTACT US. h2 is 32px/700. Text color rgb(240,181,143) appears 3 times.

observation: The palette is warm and restrained: cream/off-white page background, near-black ink, near-black section bands, and one rust-red accent (rgb 168,52,31). The accent is used for buttons, eyebrows, links and arrows.
evidence: body_bg rgb(251,247,239); body_color rgb(29,26,23); backgrounds rgb(11,10,12) ×4 and rgb(168,52,31) ×3; text rgb(168,52,31) ×27; secondary text rgb(95,88,80).

observation: The hero is a full-width dark band holding a photograph of a carved owl mask. Its left side is darkened so the text stays readable. The image is a CSS background, since the only is the logo.
evidence: e11 is a div at 0,64,1440x486 and the screenshot shows the owl mask at right. images lists only Logo.gif (40x28, alt empty). gradient_backgrounds is 0.

observation: Hero content is left-aligned in a column about 626px wide. It stacks an eyebrow, h1, serif lead paragraph and two CTAs. The photo subject sits to the right and is not overlapped by text.
evidence: e12 at 180,160 w626; e14 at 180,312 w626; the owl is at about x=990–1290.

observation: The hero has a filled primary CTA and an outlined secondary CTA side by side. The primary is a rust-red fill with white text and 6px radius. The secondary is a transparent button with a white border.

observation: The header is a dark bar with the small logo and brand text on the left and a six-link inline nav on the right. Content is held to a 1080px column starting at x=180 on a 1440px page.

observation: The booking form is a white card with a 1px border, rounded corners and one soft shadow. It contains Return/One way radios, a 5-column field row and a second row of three fields. It is the page's only shadowed element.

observation: Form labels are small bold sans text above each field. The submit button is a rust fill, with an inline sentence beside it holding a travel agent login link and a phone-reservation link.
evidence: e41 'Search flights' at 209,1040 150x43; e42 text 'Travel agent login · Reserve by phone: 888-Fly-Grant (888-359-4726)' with two anchors.

observation: The Welcome section is a two-column split. The left column has the eyebrow, h2 and a short paragraph with a bold phrase. The right column has an h3 and a bulleted list of COVID rules. The left column is much shorter than the right.
evidence: e46–e49 at x=180 w520; e50 and e51 at x=740 w520; ul height 272 against p height 54.

observation: The 'More ways to fly' section is a card grid with 3 cards in the first row and 2 in the second, which leaves one empty cell. Cards are white with a thin border and rounded corners on a cream-tint band. Each has an h3, a gray serif blurb and an underlined rust link ending in an arrow.

observation: Card heights are stretched to match the tallest card in each row. Short blurbs leave empty space below the link in the Flight schedule and Freight cards, while the Charters card fills its height.
evidence: First row cards are all 253px tall. The Charters paragraph is 136px against 54px in the other two.

observation: The Destinations section inverts to a near-black band with cream text. The eight town names are in outlined, bold sans tiles on a 5-column grid, with a peach underlined 'More about destinations →' link. The tiles are plain list items with no links.

The News column is a bordered list of dated entries. Each has a small gray date in a <time> element, a bold sans h3 title and serif links separated by a middle dot. The 2018 and 2016 entries differ in structure: one has an excerpt and the other has a PDF link.

observation: Corners are mostly square with small rounding where used. Cards, form and buttons use radii of about 6–12px, there are no pill shapes, and the page has no gradients, blur, transitions, animations or transforms.
